Third-party components used by this workbench. They are stored in this
repository and loaded with relative URLs. Opening the workbench does not
require a CDN.

Univer 1.4.0
  Files: vendor/univer-1.4.0.js, vendor/univer-1.4.0.css
  Source: https://github.com/dream-num/univer
  License: Apache License, Version 2.0 (vendor/licenses/UNIVER-Apache-2.0.txt)
  The JavaScript bundle also keeps the license notices of its dependencies,
  including React (MIT).

ExcelJS 4.4.0
  File: vendor/exceljs-4.4.0.min.js
  Source: https://github.com/exceljs/exceljs
  License: MIT (vendor/licenses/EXCELJS-MIT.txt)
  Copyright (c) 2014-2019 Guyon Roche
  Dependency license notices that were already embedded in the browser bundle
  are unchanged.

The spreadsheet and Excel libraries are fetched when a product workbook is
opened or when Excel import/export runs.
